title: heptapleurum ischyrocephalum
intro: Heptapleurum ischyrocephalum, commonly known as the Himalayan maidenhair fern, is a species of flowering plant in the family Araliaceae. The plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Heptapleurum ischyrocephalum include reducing fever, relieving pain, and treating various types of infections, with its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. However, more research is needed to fully understand the efficacy and potential side effects of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
